name: encoding-reflection-any-container
description: A value stored in an interface-typed place that is a composite literal of a slice, array or map type holding interface values carries what that literal holds, so a destination reached by the place reaches the types of the values the literal stores: a map literal a function returns as any and a map literal assigned to an any field keep the exported fields of the values they hold. A map literal nothing hands to a destination keeps nothing, so a field only its value carries is reported as written and never read.
